# Data
```{r}
state_wis <- read.csv("C:/Projects/ForecastEvaluation/Data/state-scoring/state_wis.csv")
standard_wis <- read.csv("C:/Projects/ForecastEvaluation/Data/standard-scoring/standard_wis.csv")
state_wis = state_wis |> rename(state_wis = wis)
```

# Subfigures
## Figure 2a
```{r}
complete_wis <- state_wis %>%
  left_join(standard_wis, by = intersect(colnames(state_wis), colnames(standard_wis)))

complete_wis$relative_wis <- complete_wis$state_wis / complete_wis$wis
complete_wis = complete_wis |> select("location", "target_end_date", "horizon", "reference_date",  "model_id", "target", "wis",  "state_wis",    "relative_wis")
```

```{r}
sum(is.na(complete_wis)) 
na <- complete_wis %>%
  filter(if_any(everything(), is.na))

table(na$location)
table(na$target_end_date)
table(na$model_id)
```
